headline: Approved a lease change for Laurel View Golf Course 11-2 and an extension of the ice rink management agreement with 595 Mix Avenue LLC.
summary: Two consent calendar items passed unanimously: the appointment of W. Lee Palmer as human resources director and a union agreement with UPSEU Local 424-Unit 1. Council met in executive session on collective bargaining and heard public input. A grant application from the 2025 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant was pulled to be heard in committee later.
decisions: Approved the appointment of W. Lee Palmer as human resources director for a finite term, passed unanimously.
Approved the memorandum of agreement with Local 424-Unit 1 of UPSEU, passed unanimously.
Approved the amendment and extension of the ice rink management services agreement with 595 Mix Avenue LLC, passed unanimously.
Accepted the Laurel View Golf Course lease agreement as redlined, 11-2.
Approved the Laurel View Golf Course lease modification as amended, 11-2.
Pulled the grant item so it can be heard in committee at a future meeting.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
REGULAR MEETING 
 
AUGUST 24, 2026  
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President 
Present -Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min Leader 
Absent - Tasha Hunt, Majority Whip 
Present - Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell  
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Present - Ted Stevens 
Present - Tameeka Parks   
1. MEETING CONVENES – Call of the Meeting and Taking of the Roll 
Legislative Council Regular Meeting, August 24, 2026.  The meeting was called to 
order at 7:30pm with the members noted above in attendance.  President Kiely and 
Council member Hunt were absent.  
  
 
Leadership Update  
          4. (a.) Finance Update, including audit progression.  
Finance Committee Chair Alston reported that there had been no significant Audit 
updates since the previous Council meeting. He noted that the Council had approved 
the contract extension with CBIZ and that the Administration was working to gather 
the archived 2023 financial records needed to support the expanded audit scope. 
Chair Alston also reported that the Committee was awaiting updates as CBIZ 
established the tracking process for the 2023 audit work. 
 
         4. (b.) Communication Submission Calendar  
No information was shared on this at this evening’s meeting.  
  5. News and Announcements 
No one had news/announcements to share this evening.  
  6. Celebrations –  
There were no celebrations reported during this evening’s meeting.  
2. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, COMMISSIONS, AND COUNCIL LIAISONS  
  1. Announcement of Upcoming Boards & Commission Meetings 
President Pro Tem Cardwell noted that information regarding upcoming Board and 
Commission meetings was included in the backup materials and suggested 
individuals could find updates there.  
  2. Committee Reports 
There were no committee reports for this evening.  
  3. Update on Economic Development 
Director Fontana was not available for this evening’s meeting.  He will present at a 
future session.
4. BOE Liaison Updates -Upcoming School Calendar 
BOE Liaison Parks reported that there were no updates at this time. The next Board 
of Education meeting will be on Tuesday, September 8th.  Visit Recent Agendas & 
Minutes for details.  
3. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION AND CORRESPONDENCE 
The Public Input session was opened at 7:39pm.  Three individuals came forward to 
speak.  Public Input was closed at 7:46pm.  Pro Tem Cardwell noted that we received two 
pieces of public input as well as an item of correspondence. 
 
EXECUTIVE SESSION 
Pro Tem Cardwell called for a motion to add an Executive Session to the evening’s agenda for 
the purpose of strategy and negotiations related to collective bargaining.  Joining Council 
members in the Executive Session, Finance Director Hul and Attorney Nick Grello.  
Motion: Gallagher 
Second: Figlar 
Vote: All in favor and the motion passed unanimously.  The Legislative Council went into 
Executive Session at 7:48pm. 
 
Council members returned from Executive Session at 8:58pm.  Roll was taken and the 
following members were present: 
Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Sarah Gallagher, Maj Leader 
Bob Anthony, Min Leader 
Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
Maurine Crouch 
Doug Foley 
Jeron Alston 
Abdul Osmanu 
Rhonda Caldwell  
Grace Teodosio 
Adrian Webber 
Ted Stevens 
Tameeka Parks   
4. CONSENT CALENDAR  
  1. Passed Unanimously through Admin Committee on 8/17 ORDER PROVIDING FOR 
THE APPOINTMENT OF W. LEE PALMER AS THE HUMAN RESOURCES 
DIRECTOR FOR A FINITE TERM  
  2. Passed unanimously through Admin Committee on 8/17 Order Approving and 
Authorizing the Mayor to Sign a Memorandum of Agreement Between the Town of 
Hamden and Local 424-Unit 1 of the United Public Service Employees Union 
(UPSEU) 
 
Pro Tem Cardwell called for a motion to open the Consent Calendar: 
Motion: Anthony 
Second: Figlar  
 
He then called for a motion to bundle the items: 
Motion: Anthony 
Second: Parks
Vote: All in favor. 
 
Pro Tem called for the vote to pass Items 4.1 and 4.2.  All were in favor, and the 
items passed unanimously. 
  
5. UNFINISHED BUSINESS  
  1. ORDER APPROVING AN AMENDMENT AND EXTENSION OF MANAGEMENT 
SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TOWN OF HAMDEN AND 595 MIX 
AVENUE LLC - ICE RINK Passed through PWP Committee on 8/17 with 1 in 
opposition.   
 
Motion to open the item: Figlar 
Second: Parks   
Vote: 12 in favor, 1 opposed (Teodosio), 0 abstentions.  Motion to open the item 
passed. 
 
Motion to move the item: Anthony 
Second: Gallagher 
Pro Tem Cardwell read out the amended memo from Mayor Sendroff in which he 
updates the membership of the Committee to Explore Ice Rink Management to 
include Council member Teodosio.  With no questions/comments from Council 
members, Pro Tem Cardwell called for the vote. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  The item passed unanimously. 
  
  2. SECOND AMENDMENT ORDER AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO EXECUTE A 
LEASE MODIFICATION FOR LAUREL VIEW GOLF COURSE Passed through 
Committee on 8/17 with 2 in opposition.   
 
Motion to open the item: Anthony 
Second: Figlar 
Pro Tem Cardwell shared an update to the Lease Agreement provided by the 
Administration and then took comments/questions from Council members, members 
Osmanu, Stevens, Gallagher, Caldwell, and Teodosio spoke. 
 
Motion to accept the agreement as redlined: Gallagher 
Second: Figlar 
Pro Tem Cardwell called for the vote to accept the agreement as redlined.  
Vote: 11 in favor, 2 opposed, 0 abstentions.  
 
Motion to approve the item as amended: Anthony 
Second: Figlar    
Vote: 11 in favor, 2 opposed, 0 abstentions. 
  
6. NEW BUSINESS  
  1. DISCUSSION FROM COMMITTEE: ON ORDER AUTHORIZING THE TOWN OF 
HAMDEN TO APPLY AND IF AWARDED ACCEPT AND EXPEND FUNDS FROM 
THE 2025 EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT FROM 
THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE
Pro Tem Cardwell pulled this item so that it could be heard in Committee at a future 
meeting.  
   
ADJOURNMENT 
With no additional business before the Council, Pro Tem Cardwell asked for a motion to 
adjourn.   
Motion: Figlar 
Second: Gallagher.   
 
The meeting adjourned at 9:21pm.
